title: Refresh strategy registry persona router port provisioning and synthesis tests

ac_1_all_triaged_tests_pass.detail: All 146 tests across the 5 scoped test suites pass cleanly without regressing previously passing BFF behavior.

ac_2_classification_and_rigor.detail: Each changed expectation is classified with deciding commit references (1e503188a, 18aa49157, dbbb2a401, e32ab2785, 99a523e50, 8ca8f2d8f, f19470ebd). No assertion was weakened; assertions were tightened (e.g. status_code in (200, 404) -> status_code == 404, asserting exact synthesis call count, asserting degraded and unavailable fault paths).

ac_3_no_compressed_code.detail: Standard idiomatic formatting preserved; no artificial compression or minification used.

triage_classifications.description: JWT requires tenant_id claim in addition to tenant. Added tenant_id to _strict_token() helper and provided valid auth_token in TestHttpRequestJsonMethodDispatch tests so owner outbound HTTP dispatch passes authentication preflight without 403 TENANT_MISMATCH.

persona_router fixture used an unconfigured write owner for read surface ports, causing queries to fail with 503 DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE instead of 404. Injected FakePersonaStore with typed_store status, strengthened assertions from status_code in (200, 404) to status_code == 404, and added test_unconfigured_owner_returns_503 to verify fail-closed 503 behavior when owner is unconfigured.

Reachable empty owner reports ok (empty records from healthy provider is normal, not degraded). Renamed test_empty_records_degraded to test_empty_records_ok asserting ok status, and added explicit test cases for degraded (missing bindings) and unavailable (downstream error) states in TestCapitalPoolPort.

Persona discovery service resolves seed store from strategies.service rather than seeds_module. Patched strategies.service.StrategySpecSeedStore in test_dev_paper_baseline_strategy_seed_route_excludes_other_tenant_persona to correctly intercept seed store initialization.

Provider fake gains invoke_structured_extraction method matching contract. Opinion ids in synthesis assertions are compared using sorted() order, and single synthesis call is asserted via getattr(provider, 'synthesis_calls', 0) == 1.
